newsitem.title: FRANCE: Air Liquide wins GE Plastics Dutch deal.
newsitem.headline: Air Liquide wins GE Plastics Dutch deal.

text.p: French Air Liquide said on Tuesday it had won a contract to supply all the carbon monoxide needs of General Electric Plastics' Lexan plant in Bergen op Zoom in the Netherlands.

"Within the framework of the long-term contract signed with GEP, Air Liquide will take over the existing carbon monoxide plant of GEP and will build and operate a new plant at the Bergen op Zoom site," it said in a statement.
It said it would invest around 400 million francs and that the new plant was scheduled for start-up in the first quarter of 1999.
